title: ScenarioContract
description: Schema for candidate operational trajectory scenarios evaluated by the Consequence Engine.

scenario_id.description: Unique identifier for the generated scenario.

action_id.description: Action archetype ID (e.g., ACT-CONTINUE, ACT-RESEQUENCE, ACT-REPOSITION).

title.description: Short human-readable title of the alternative trajectory.

description.description: Detailed explanation of what this operational trajectory entails.

parameters.description: Operational parameters varied in this scenario (e.g. idle reduction, route modification).

explanation.description: Natural language rationale explaining why this trajectory is feasible/rejected and its trade-offs.
